items.mainDefect: Removing a member with group.users.delete skips callbacks, leaving groups.user_count too high.

secondary.defect: Removing a member skips primary_group_id cleanup, so the removed user can retain the group as their primary group.

items.mainDefect: Negative limit or offset values reach PostgreSQL and cause a 500 response.

secondary.defect: Very large limits are accepted, allowing a request to load every group member.

items.mainDefect: Negative offset or limit values reach PostgreSQL and cause a 500 response.

secondary.defect: A zero limit is returned in metadata and causes client pagination calculations to produce NaN or Infinity.
Very large limits are accepted, allowing a request to load every group member.
